id.description: Server-generated, never set by a submitter. A UUID v4, or 'nexus-<modId>' for the nine records imported from auto-discovery before the cutover. The legacy form is a closed set: nothing mints a new one.

credits.description: Additional credits for teams or contributors without specific Nexus profiles

coordinates.description: [X, Y, Z] — in-game coordinates from Cyber Engine Tweaks (X = east/west, Y = north/south, Z = height/elevation). Z is required for new submissions; existing entries with only [X, Y] remain valid.

yaw.description: Optional. Player facing direction in degrees from CET output (extracted from GetWorldOrientation():ToEulerAngles().yaw).

nexus_id.description: The Nexus Mods ID (number), or 'WIP' / 'Dummy' for unpublished content

category.description: Category of the mod: location-overhaul, new-location, or other

tags.description: Tags for filtering and additional info (styles, lifepaths, etc.)
